**Spanish**
- The Spanish translation is updated by Deliond.

**New**
- *Preferences > Reset configuration* puts the default menu files back. Your current files are saved in *Backups* first, so you can undo it there.
- New menus and items in the Menu Builder, and new apps in *Open with*, start with a title in your language. Titles you already have stay as they are.

**Fixes**
- Sidebar icons no longer break into pieces after you move the mouse over the entries.
- The icon box in the Menu Builder grows with its text, so longer words like "Ninguno" fit.

**Links**
- *Preferences > About > Report an issue* opens this project's Issues again, with simple forms for bug reports and ideas. Questions are welcome in [Discussions](https://github.com/Abdullah-Masood-05/Shell/discussions).
